safety: SIMULATED provider boundaries; real local UI, authentication, pricing, callback verification and isolated database persistence. No real payment or live email.

steps.label: Landing page
steps.description: Open the storefront with a fresh browser state and reject optional cookies.

steps.label: Register account
steps.description: Fill the real registration form with synthetic details and required terms/privacy consent; CAPTCHA is simulated.

steps.label: Submit registration
steps.description: Submit Create Account and verify the application advances to email verification or its login screen.

steps.label: Verify email
steps.description: Follow the real verification link captured by the local-only SMTP sink.

steps.label: Login form
steps.description: Enter the newly registered account email/password in the real login form.

steps.label: Login succeeds
steps.description: Submit Sign In and confirm the server session belongs to the verified synthetic user.

steps.label: Search products
steps.description: Use the storefront search UI to search for Audit and verify both catalogue fixtures are returned.

steps.label: Select product 1
steps.description: Open the INR 4,999 synthetic television detail page.

steps.label: Add product 1 to cart
steps.description: Click the real Add to Cart control; no cart data is injected by the runner.

steps.label: Select product 2
steps.description: Open the INR 6,999 synthetic television detail page.

steps.label: Add product 2 to cart
steps.description: Click the real Add to Cart control; no cart data is injected by the runner.

steps.label: Two-product cart
steps.description: Open the cart and verify both distinct products, quantity one each, are present.

steps.label: Checkout
steps.description: Use the cart checkout control to enter authenticated checkout.

steps.label: Delivery address
steps.description: Fill synthetic customer/address data and save Bangalore delivery, pincode 560001.

steps.label: Choose payment gateway
steps.description: Select razorpay and verify the checkout branding matches the chosen provider.

steps.label: Start simulated payment
steps.description: Click Pay Now. The real app calculates the amount; only the provider boundary is simulated.

steps.label: Complete payment and confirmation
steps.description: Click the labelled simulated success control. The real application verifies signed proof/provider status and displays the two-item order confirmation.

steps.label: Order history
steps.description: Open authenticated order history and verify the completed order is visible.

steps.label: Cart cleared and persistence verified
steps.description: Reload the cart and verify it is empty; independently assert confirmed order, completed payment, consumed intent, exact paid total and two products in the isolated database.
